issue.body:
How much `pr_runtime` validation coverage is lost through test recognition, command selection and output parsing? Follow-up to #28. Investigation remains open.

**Live result:** excluding deleted test paths removes Matchms PR958's missing-file error, but both stages then fail collection because historical code imports missing `chemap`; no task is recovered. PR671 retains its original 1 fail-to-pass and 30 pass-to-pass tests. [Evidence](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/40a80ef0/experiments/32-runner-coverage/target-live-diagnosis.json).

**Candidates:** a default-off literal pytest targeting policy passes selection and package-routing checks. A separate completion gate detects hidden inner pytest errors in native and exported fixture runs. These are synthetic checks; neither candidate has recovered a biological task. An original SAMtools `make test` run confirms the parser gap: 523 case-heading occurrences use only 29 names (`test_sort` repeats 36 times), while the Perl summary counts 1,052 cases and other make components follow. It needs stable case identities and a composite C/Perl/shell contract. [Original log audit](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/22fe6841/experiments/32-runner-coverage/samtools-native-log-audit.json) · [Completion checks](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/ae0ef75b/experiments/32-runner-coverage/pytest-completion-protocol.md) · [SAMtools contract](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/a236dc9d/experiments/32-runner-coverage/samtools-runner-contract.md).

**MNE:** the unchanged replay matched 12 recorded bootstrap exits of 127, then its full-suite smoke check timed out at 300 seconds after 28% progress. It produced no image or PR14445 validation. One comparison is now running with only the exact smoke/fresh limits raised to 1,200 seconds; its outcome is pending. [Protocol](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/4b3bc656/experiments/32-runner-coverage/mne-longcheck-protocol.md).

**Next:** read back the MNE result; assess live targeting, parser and completion behavior with frozen cases and complete positive controls before any recovery claim. The two prior jobs used 0.72125 allocated CPU-hours; the active comparison reserves at most 5 more under the 10-hour ceiling. Zero model calls or new capacity. Prior archives and cleanup are verified; current cleanup is pending. No production change promoted. Detailed logs remain in comments.

comment.body:
🤖 Read-only audit of the verified public #28 SAMtools phase archive found a full original bootstrap `make test` run at ref `d4fd5c9d`. The command exited 0 in 46.995 seconds. Its output has 523 per-test heading occurrences using only 29 names; `test_sort` repeats 36 times. The Perl summary reports 1,052 total cases: 1,020 passed, 32 expected failures, no ordinary failures or unexpected passes. The make output continues with other test components after the Perl summary.

This is direct evidence that a parser keyed by heading would collapse distinct cases. Heading occurrences also do not equal the complete Perl count. The run was bootstrap smoke at a different ref from frozen PR1605, so it does not establish PR validation, adapter correctness, task export or positive controls. The source archive and member hashes were verified; raw log remains in private local research storage. No remote job or model call was added.

[Counts and hashes](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/22fe6841/experiments/32-runner-coverage/samtools-native-log-audit.json) · [Contract](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/22fe6841/experiments/32-runner-coverage/samtools-runner-contract.md).
